text.p: Orvana Minerals Corp said on Wednesday it entered into a private placement financing worth C$18.75 million.
Orvana said it would sell three million special warrants priced at C$6.25 each in the private placement.
The company said it agreed to pay a commission of six percent of the gross proceeds to the agents.
The financing was expected to close by November 18, with the funds to be held in escrow and released after the prospectus was received in all Canadian provinces where the special warrants were sold.

The proceeds would be used for exploration of Orvana's Pederson project in Bolivia and the Butte Highlands project in Montana as well as for the completion of an exploration program at the Don Mario project in Bolivia, Orvana said.
